name: openbb_crypto_price
description:
Daily price history for one cryptocurrency pair through the OpenBB Platform (obb.crypto.price.historical).
Returns: {symbol, provider, data_points, start_date, end_date, prices: [{date, open, high, low, close, volume}]} or {symbol, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol (pair, upper-cased, e.g. BTCUSD, ETHUSD; default BTCUSD); start_date (default 90 days ago); end_date (default today); provider (fmp, polygon, tiingo, yfinance; default yfinance).
Other sources: av_crypto_daily, yf_crypto_info, cg_coin_market_chart. Keys: yfinance needs none; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY; polygon, tiingo need a key in ~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json.
Example: {"symbol": "ETHUSD", "start_date": "2026-07-01"}

symbol.description: Pair without separator, e.g. BTCUSD, ETHUSD
